note: Small campground with cabins and a horse barn at the foot of Holston Mountain on Morrell Creek, beside Cherokee National Forest; most sites are gravel back-ins (site 19 is the pull-through). Access roads are narrow; a 30-ft trailer reportedly fit. --Claude
summary: Private campground confirmed on its own site: RV sites $39.56 + tax (4 people), 30-amp FHU, cash/check only; 21 numbered nightly sites + remote no-electric + hammock site on the map; Wi-Fi, laundry. Passes price + presence (Google 4.4/103). HORSE question flagged: a 14-stall barn and two paddocks sit in the middle of the grounds; horse trailers park on the ordinary nightly sites. Website Facebook -> cherokeetrailscampground.com.
flags: HORSE RULE (reviewer): the operator markets general camping ('Bring your tent, camper, hammock or stay in one of our 7 cabins') and horses are kept in a '14 Stall Barn' ($13.67/night) and 'Two Paddocks', not at the sites; but the barn and paddocks stand in the middle of the campground beside the bathhouse and sites 14-17 (campground map), and the operator's own site photo shows a horse trailer parked on a gravel nightly site. There is no separate horse loop and no rule keeping horse rigs off the general sites. Under AWH 2026-11-12 ('campgrounds that do not explicitly separate the horse areas from the general camping areas are not allowed') this reads as a DROP CANDIDATE; against it, the sites are not horse sites (no tie-outs, horses stalled in a barn) and the horse content is a stable beside a general campground. Reviewer to decide.

PRICE/PRESENCE (private): $39.56 + tax a night for an RV site with full hookups, posted on the operator's live site (read 2026-11-24; no year on the page) - under the US$50 gate. Google Maps 4.4 (103 reviews); RV Life 4.5*/$$ stored. Working website with phone 423-391-0118.
LONG-STAY: 'Please call for Seasonal & Long term rates', but every numbered RV site on the map is a 'Nightly Site' and a nightly rate is posted; tests pass.
WEBSITE: stored Facebook page -> https://www.cherokeetrailscampground.com/ (the operator's own site, linked from Google Maps). Phone 423-391-0118 confirmed.

SITES: the map shows 21 numbered nightly sites (#1-19, #21, #22) plus green 'Remote Sites (no electric)' and #23 hammock site; stored count 22 (note prose) left alone. SEASON: the stored 'Open March to November' (derived from note prose) is not stated on the operator's site; left as is, unconfirmed.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The map labels a 'Creek' (Morrell Creek) beside sites 21-22 and the creekside camp cabins, but imagery shows only canopy there; a possible creekside lead for 21-22 that I could not measure.
Pin 36.47990,-82.11684 is on the campground road (~70 m from Google's point); fine. Bristol Motor Speedway race weeks are priced differently (not posted).
